With the recent growth of artificial intelligence use on the University of Missouri campus through the introduction of the AI Use Scale and Show-Me AI, students and professors have started to express their concerns.

Nicole Monnier, teaching professor of Russian, is on the Academic Affairs Committee and the General Education Task Force. She has heard cynicism from fellow faculty and students alike regarding the rise of AI.
